best_addon.why: No pick yet: the popular-strategy files (ICT + classic) have not landed. Sample rows and LIT variants are never picked.

rows.name: LIT (Zlarior)
rules: Sweep of a liquidity level (>= 0.5 ATR) after an inducement, then displacement and a 5m CISD back through it.
Limit at the CISD level (30 min), a 1m CISD confirms; entry at the next 1m open, 1 trade a day 02:00-15:30 ET.
Stop 1 tick beyond the sweep extreme, size follows the stop; one target: the VIX band, banked at 8R.

rows.name: ATLAS (EMA + MACD + S/R)
rules: Three lobes, each its own hours and 1 trade a day: EMA trend pullback, MACD divergence at a sweep, S/R sweep + reclaim.
Entry at the next 5m open after the trigger close; LIT goes first (no ATLAS entry while LIT is in a trade).
Stop beyond the setup's sweep wick; VIX-band target (S/R: 2R); breakeven + costs at 1R.

rows.name: SAMPLE · ICT Silver Bullet
rules: 10:00-11:00 ET only: a liquidity sweep, then a fair value gap in the new direction.
Entry on the return into the FVG.
Stop past the sweep; target the opposite liquidity.

rows.name: SAMPLE · ICT Judas swing
rules: A false move at the NY open into a session high or low.
Entry on the market structure shift back.
Stop past the false move; target the other side of the range.

rows.name: SAMPLE · ICT OTE retracement
rules: A displacement leg, then a 62-79% retracement (the OTE zone).
Entry inside the zone on a 1m shift.
Stop past the leg's start; target the leg's extreme and beyond.

rows.name: SAMPLE · Opening range breakout
rules: The first 15 minutes after 09:30 ET set the range.
Entry on a 5m close outside it.
Stop at the range's other side; target 2R.

rows.name: SAMPLE · VWAP 2-sigma reversion
rules: Price stretches 2 standard deviations from the session VWAP.
Entry on the first 5m close back inside the band.
Stop past the stretch extreme; target VWAP.

rows.name: SAMPLE · RSI(2) pullback
rules: Trend filter: price above the 200 EMA (1h).
Entry when RSI(2) drops under 10 on the 5m.
Exit when RSI(2) is back over 70; stop 1.5 ATR.
